PProfile.Safety.Desc:
Set your boundary for romantic dialogues.
- Unrestricted: Flirtations allowed with anyone.
- Relaxed: Casual banter if context fits.
- Hearts Matter: Subtle romance only at high friendship.
- Committed Only: Exclusively with date/spouse.

friendshipNote: (Base social familiarity; your actual emotional fondness/trust must be guided by your [IMPRESSIONS OF THE FARMER] and memories)
friendshipFirstMeeting: - Social Standing: First meeting (-1 hearts). Complete strangers. {{Note}}
friendshipStrangers: - Social Standing: Distant acquaintances ({{Hearts}} hearts). Basic social boundaries apply. {{Note}}
friendshipNeighbors: - Social Standing: Familiar neighbors ({{Hearts}} hearts). Casual, surface-level neighborly rapport. {{Note}}
friendshipFriends: - Social Standing: Well-acquainted friends ({{Hearts}} hearts). Familiar with each other's routines. {{Note}}
friendshipCloseFriends: - Social Standing: Highly familiar companions ({{Hearts}} hearts). Zero conversational formality. {{Note}}
friendshipChild8Plus: - Social Standing: Very familiar presence ({{Hearts}} hearts). Childlike openness. {{Note}}
friendshipDating: - Social Standing: Dating relationship ({{Hearts}} hearts). Public romantic involvement. {{Note}}
friendshipBestFriends: - Social Standing: Closely bound best friends ({{Hearts}} hearts). High social proximity. {{Note}}
friendshipLongTermBond: - Social Standing: Deeply established long-term bond ({{Hearts}} hearts). Complete conversational ease. {{Note}}
greetingYesterday: - This is your first conversation today. You spoke yesterday — naturally continue from yesterday's thread or give a light greeting. Avoid a stiff 'Good morning', but acknowledge seeing them again.
greetingFewDays: - This is your first conversation today. It has been {{DayGap}} days since you last spoke. Re-establish connection naturally — reference your last conversation or note their recent presence.
greetingLongTime: - First conversation today after {{DayGap}} days apart. Show a sense of catching up — you might wonder what they've been up to.
interactionOngoingState: - Status: Ongoing interaction after initial greetings today.
interactionOngoingGoal: - Goal: Directly continue the ongoing topic or atmosphere naturally.
interactionApproaching: The farmer has walked over. Acknowledge their presence naturally or share what is on your mind.
weatherDescSun: Clear skies and pleasant sunshine with a gentle breeze outside.
weatherDescRain: A steady rain is falling outside, leaving the earth damp and fresh.
weatherDescStorm: Thunder rumbles outside amidst a torrential downpour and heavy wind.
weatherDescSnow: Snow is falling thick and heavy outside, bringing a crisp, biting chill.
weatherDescWind: Gusty winds are blowing through town, scattering leaves and debris.
weatherDescGreenRain: An eerie green rain falls outside, filling the air with wild moss and overgrown flora.
sceneSpatialCoPresent: - Spatial Status: Co-present with the farmer. Focus on reacting to their presence and active conversation.
sceneFestivalActive: - Special Event: Attending the {{Festival}} with a festive atmosphere.
sceneFestivalToday: - Special Event: Today is the {{Festival}}, preparations are underway.
